annotation.title_clean: CASA 67/24 — Operation of RPA in Sydney Harbour Restricted Areas, R405A and R405B (CASA-Verified Drone Safety App) Instrument 2024
annotation.title_en: CASA 67/24 — Operation of RPA in Sydney Harbour Restricted Areas, R405A and R405B (CASA-Verified Drone Safety App) Instrument 2024
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA); administered by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
annotation.summary_en: Federal Register of Legislation landing page for CASA instrument 67/24 (F2024L01461), made under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998. It governs how remotely piloted aircraft (drones) may operate in the Sydney Harbour restricted areas R405A and R405B when using a CASA-verified drone safety app. Only metadata is shown, not the instrument's text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Authorised by the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998
Governs drone operations in the Sydney Harbour restricted areas R405A and R405B
Ties permitted operation to use of a CASA-verified drone safety app
